description: Chip sets group related chips into one input, filter, or selection list.

tags.devx:
- Works best as controlled: pass `items` + `onItemsChange`.
- Prefer stable item ids; without one, ids follow object identity.
tags.a11y:
- The collection has a configurable accessible label.
- Arrow, Home, End, Backspace, and Delete keys are supported in input mode.
tags.limitations: - No virtualization; very large lists can be slow.

className.name: className
className.description: Root classes (string), static element classes (object), or state-aware element classes (function).

label.name: label
label.description: Accessible name for the chip collection.

variant.name: variant
variant.description: Enables inline input and removal behavior.

scrollable.name: scrollable
scrollable.description: Uses horizontal overflow instead of wrapping.

draggable.name: draggable
draggable.description: Enables native dragging on every chip.

items.name: items
items.description: Controlled source of truth for the collection.

onItemsChange.name: onItemsChange
onItemsChange.description: Notifies list changes caused by selection, editing, or removal.

tags.devx: Pass stable `ChipItem.id` values when the collection can be reordered and replace the list from `itemsChange`.
tags.a11y: Renders a labelled list; each chip retains its native button or link semantics.
tags.limitations:
- Does not virtualize large lists.
- `[class.x]` and `[ngClass]` bind to the `display: contents` host and have no visible effect; use `class`, `[class]`, or `classes`.
